notes.title: 100K Copies Sold + Whats Next for Keep on Mining? + Trading Cards!
notes.content: [p][b]100K copies sold![/b][/p][p]First I have to say that the last few weeks have been nuts. The game has sold over 100K copies and it is currently sitting at 93% positive reviews. The game's success exceeded my expectations by a crazy amount so I want to thank everyone for your support![/p][p][/p][p][b]Whats next for Keep on Mining?[/b][/p][p]There is a lot to talk about but let's start with the upcoming mobile port. I am currently working on getting the game out on mobile, both iOS and Android. It will most likely be priced the same on mobile as on steam. (Give or take 5$ based on where you live. The game will not be free as I very much dislike ads and IAP and I will most likely always stick to the "buy the game, you get the game and that's it" business model)[/p][p]Now what about updates? There have been a lot of suggestions/feedback on things to add to the game and a lot of it is really good. But as the game currently stands, it is a short and sweet experience and I very much want it to stay that way. The plan from the very beginning was always to have this game be short quality experience that can be beaten relatively quickly and I am going to stick with that.[/p][p]Buuut... a sequel, maybe?[/p][p]As I mentioned, there has been a lot of good suggestions & feedback from players and I myself have a lot of ideas. And since I think this gameplay loop is really fun, perhaps a sequel is in order? Nothing is decided yet, but if I end up making a sequel, it will most likely be a much longer game. Still a short game relative to other incremental games, but I'm thinking somewhere between a 10-20 hours long game.[/p][p]What would the potential sequel add, keep and change from the original?: It will keep the same gameplay loop (hover rocks, pickaxes mines rocks, collect ores, upgrade, and go back to mining). The talent system will most likely be reworked but I still want to keep talent upgrades. The Mine will either be re worked or expanded. The Anvil will most likely stay the same but perhaps you can both craft and upgrade pickaxes? (similar to the cursor system in Treasure Chest Clicker) I'm also thinking the sequel would have levels. Keep on Mining! only has 1 level with the green tiles. I'm thinking the sequel will have a snow level, desert level and other cool unique levels. And of course the sequel will have a lot more upgrades, pickaxes and artifacts to collect. [/p][p]Leave your thought of this below! I'd love hear what you guys think and I would also like to hear some more ideas.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Trading cards![/b][/p][p]The community items are now released! You can collect a total of 7 different trading cards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661010/2aa5825f5ea9553df4a9c9ceeddbaed1eb5984a7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Again, I want to thank all of you for making Keep on Mining! such a huge success![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45661010/3ac7252f4764a73c445c5cd1b46e6fc491ee08e1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch #6 + A note about the steam deck version!
notes.content:
[b]Fixed some bugs![/b]
-Lowered the price of the King’s companion.
-Fixed a bug where if you: 1. Have revealed the talent cards. 2. Close the game. 3. Reset the game in the main menu. 4. When you go back to the talents tabs, the 3 cards that block the talent cards will not show, which means that the first talent card would be free.
-Fixed a bug where if you use an auto clicker on the endless upgrades, there is a chance to purchase 2 upgrades at the same time, resulting in the total bars numbers going into the minus.

[b]-Big lag freeze bug fix:[/b] This one was interesting. There was a bug that would appear once a mining session is done. The game would freeze for a slight moment and the “Mining session done!” frame animation would not play, it would only appear after a short while. The Gold Ring artifact was the cause of this. The Gold Ring makes it so that for every mined ore, it has a chance of only using 1 ore to craft 1 bar. That means once the player has gotten far into the game and mines 1M+ ores in one mining session, each ore will execute some code. That means if the player mines a total of 100 million ores, the code will be executed 100 million times AND if a D100 rolls 1, 10 or 100, then the code will be executed 500 MILLION TIMES! I’m not sure how my game never crashed from this.

[b]A note about the steam deck version![/b]
So there has been some reports of the steam cloud not working properly on steam deck and this is something that I am aware of. Before release I spent a lot of hours trying to get this fixed but with no success. The steam cloud works from PC to PC, PC to Steam Deck but not from Steam Deck to PC. So if you play it on PC, then Steam Deck, it should save over. But if you play it on steam deck and then on your PC, it does not save over.

I have talked to a lot of game developers who got this working and I have even set up the steam cloud exactly the same way as them but for some reason it does not want to work. I will continue with trying to get it working but I thought I might make an announcement about this just as an heads up for players who are considering playing it on steam deck.

However, the game is playable on steam deck, so if you are just planning on playing in steam deck, then go ahead! Please not that the games Steam Deck Compatibility Review is set to "Playable" and not "Verified." There are some in-game texts that shows PC controls and not Steam Deck controls and some text might be a bit small to read.

notes.title: Endless Upgrades update! + Patch #5
notes.content:
[b]This update introduces the Endless Upgrades.[/b]

Once all of the skill tree upgrades has been purchased, 8 upgrades will appear at the top of the skill tree. These upgrades can be continuously purchased and the price of each upgrade will increase each time it is purchased. These upgrades will upgrade 4 core stats, Ore Value, XP Increase, Pickaxe Stats and 2X double ore/XP chance. There is 1 upgrade for each of the 8 different materials, this means that each material has a use once the game has been completed.

[b]Also did some minor changes.[/b]
-When switching between tabs, the skill tree screen will stay at the same position as where you left it. It will only get set to the middle when pressing play in the main menu and pressing the UPGRADE button after a mining session is done.
-Fixed an issue with some translated text. Once there are less than 3 talent cards left, grey cards will appear with some text that tells the player if there are only 2, 1 or no more talent cards left. This text did not change from English when changing language. 
-Fixed some minor bugs.

notes.title: Patch #4
notes.content:
[b]Did some game balance![/b]

-Midas Touch appear chance from 15% to 20%
-Gilded Treasure ore spawn count from 40 to 50.
-Regular chest spawn chance from 0.5% to 0.6%.
-Made the campfire bigger. Also increases the collider size.
-Energy Drinker trigger chance from 6% to 7%.
-Inflate Burst now has the same trigger chance and effect time (3 sec) as Energy Drinker.
-Improved X Marks The Spot and the Explorer talent card.
-I also did some balancing on a few skill tree upgrade prices. Slightly increased a few and slightly decreased a few prices.

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.content:
More bug fixes!

-Fixed a bug where if the player reset the game after choosing all talent cards, no talent cards would appear the next time you reveal the talent cards. This would also cause the game to crash on game startup. 
-Fixed a bug related to the Shape Shifter and the Inflate Burst talent. The Inflate Burst would only affect the circle UNLESS you have purchased the In and Out skill tree upgrade.
-Fixed a bug where if you only have 1 or 2 talent cards left, exit the game, then when you open the game and try to select a talent card, the talent card cannot be selected and you are not able to press on anything except the settings and main menu.

notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
[b]Fixed some bugs![/b]

-Fixed a bug where you could drag the bottom left XP bar and get infinite levels.
-Fixed a bug where the "Crafting…" text would mess in a few different languages.
-Replaced the Portuguese flag with the Brazil flag. 
-Fixed an issue where if you have the last pickaxe, the Inflate Burst and the Shape Shifter talent cards, the game would spawn too many pickaxes, which could cause the game to lag. 
-Potential bug fix, I’m still looking into this bug: Once The Mine has been upgraded a lot, the mined bars could cause the object pool to overlap. (This means that the game keeps spawning objects that will never be reused and never deleted. Aka cause the game to use more and more ram) That might still be an issue. Let me know if some of you are still experiencing this.

notes.title: Patch #1 + An announcement!
notes.content:
This patch fixes some small bugs and adds some QOL. 

-Corrected some wrong French text translations. 
-Corrected some typos. 
-Newly crafted pickaxes will now be instantly equipped. If you craft a pickaxe that is worse than the one you have equipped (Example: if you have pickaxe nr. 10 equipped but craft nr. 9), then it will not be instantly equipped. 
-Fixed a bug that would cause the skill tree upgrade tooltip to glitch out if the upgrade text description is long. This was mostly an issue in French and German. 
-Added an info tooltip next to the stats inside The Mine tab button that gives some information about the mined bars. This info tells the player that the Ore Value skill tree upgrades also affect the mined bars from The Mine. This was not properly explained to the player before this patch. 

[b]announcement[/b]
So it's only been a little more than 24 hours since release but the game has already exceeded my expectations! I want to thank everyone who ended up purchasing it, wishlisting it or just simply taking an interest in the game!

So what's next? I will of course continue to fix any reported bugs and add some QOL if needed AND perhaps tweak the balance a bit. But when it comes to content updates, I have 1 on the horizon. As of right now I don't have any massive content updates planned since I very much want this game to be a short and sweet experience, but I have decided that I will at least make an update that adds some stuff for players who would like to continue to play the game after it's been completed. I can only tell you that as of right now, I am planning on adding some endless upgrades once the final skill tree upgrade has been purchased. This will make the game "endless," and is aimed at being for players who would like to grind it a little longer. I will most likely add some more stuff as well but I have not decided on everything. 

 You can comment ideas here but I cannot promise that I will add all your suggestions :)

notes.title: The game is still in the review process.
notes.content: [p]First let me just say that I feel your frustration, I have released plenty of incremental games in the past and never had to delay any of them past their original release date, so as you can guess, no one is more frustrated than me.[/p][p][/p][p]Although I have not heard anything new from steam, I wanted to post this announcement so that I can answer some questions from you guys and talk a little about the potential reason for the long review time.[/p][p][/p][p]First, some questions and comments from you guys:[/p][p]-[b]What is the game price?:[/b] It will be 5$ USD with a 15% release discount. Also look out for the bundles once it's released, perhaps you can get it even cheaper if you own some of my other games.[/p][p]-[b]Day 1 quality of life patch please: [/b]There have been a few content creators who have played my game, and based on their YT video/live stream, there has been some feedback from the viewers. 4 days ago I released a patch that added a plus icon on every skill tree upgrade, this shows up if the player can afford that specific upgrade. Now there is no need to hover over every single upgrade to check which ones you can afford. I also fixed some minor bugs such as the pickaxe stats would display worse stats on a newly crafted pickaxe compared to the previous pickaxe. I also improved some talent cards and The Mine. [/p][p]-[b]might just be because the 'steam sales' inside the game:[/b] So there is an upgrade in the game named "Steam Sale" with a cartoony Gaben face icon and some people have speculated that this is the reason for the delay. I don't think so. Gaben is known for being very cool about stuff like this (unless it's in bad taste) and I also have a steam sale upgrade in my first ever made game, Coin Flipper. If this was the issue, then they would get back to me just like they have done in the past when there has been an issue with any of my previous games.[/p][p][b]-Dont think the Dev is being honest. major red flags:[/b] I want the game released more than anyone. [/p][p][/p][p]Now let's talk a little about the potential reason for the long review time. [/p][p]I've done some research and it seems like I'm not the only one with this problem. Blue Archive was released on July 4 but with the original release date of June 24. VILE: Exhumed has been in the review process for over a month. [/p][p]I've also heard that steam has been forced to change their review policies by payment processors. There's the changes with NSFW games, apparently a lot of them are being removed. There was just a big steam sale and the steam automation fest. They also have been working on a lot of stuff such as being able to see the wishlist count update every hour rather than once per day. [/p][p]This is all speculation, so at the end of the day all we can do is wait. I don't want to trash steam, I love steam. I just want to release it.[/p][p][/p][p]Again, thank you guys for your patience. [/p][p] [/p]

notes.content: [p]The original release date and time was July 16, 12:00PM CEST time. But there seems to be issues on steams end.[/p][p][/p][p]Currently the game is still in the review process. I sent the game in for review on July 3, which is almost 2 weeks ago. Usually it takes between 3 and 5 days for steam to do the review process and with all my other games, that is how long it took. But Keep on Mining! is taking longer.[/p][p][/p][p]I've sent in some help requests regarding this, so that might help.[/p][p][/p][p]I will release it as soon as the game has been review and accepted. [/p][p][/p][p]Sorry about this![/p]
